mapper.insert: INSERT INTO projects (owner_id, title, description, genre, status) VALUES (#{ownerId}, #{title}, #{description}, #{genre}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT id, owner_id, title, description, genre, status, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at FROM projects WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM projects p JOIN project_members pm ON pm.project_id = p.id WHERE pm.user_id = #{userId} AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM projects p JOIN project_members pm ON pm.project_id = p.id WHERE pm.user_id = #{userId} AND pm.role = 'OWNER' AND p.deleted_at IS NOT NULL

SELECT p.id AS project_id, p.title, pm.role AS my_role, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM project_members pm2 WHERE pm2.project_id = p.id) AS member_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scenes s WHERE s.project_id = p.id) AS scene_count, p.updated_at, p.deleted_at FROM projects p JOIN project_members pm ON pm.project_id = p.id WHERE pm.user_id = #{userId} AND p.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY p.updated_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT p.id AS project_id, p.title, pm.role AS my_role, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM project_members pm2 WHERE pm2.project_id = p.id) AS member_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scenes s WHERE s.project_id = p.id) AS scene_count, p.updated_at, p.deleted_at FROM projects p JOIN project_members pm ON pm.project_id = p.id WHERE pm.user_id = #{userId} AND pm.role = 'OWNER' AND p.deleted_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY p.deleted_at DESC, p.updated_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT pm.asset_id AS video_asset_id, NULL AS video_fallback_url, pm.thumbnail_asset_id AS thumbnail_asset_id, NULL AS thumbnail_fallback_url FROM project_merges pm WHERE pm.project_id = #{projectId} AND pm.is_active = 1 AND pm.status = 'COMPLETED' AND pm.asset_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY pm.updated_at DESC, pm.id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT sv.asset_id AS video_asset_id, NULL AS video_fallback_url, COALESCE(sv.thumbnail_asset_id, master.asset_id) AS thumbnail_asset_id, COALESCE(sv.thumbnail_url, master.content_url) AS thumbnail_fallback_url FROM scenes s JOIN scene_videos sv ON sv.scene_id = s.id LEFT JOIN nodes master ON master.id = s.active_master_node_id AND master.node_type = 'MASTER' WHERE s.project_id = #{projectId} AND sv.is_active = 1 AND sv.status = 'COMPLETED' AND sv.asset_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY s.order_index ASC, s.id ASC, sv.updated_at DESC, sv.id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT n.asset_id AS video_asset_id, n.content_url AS video_fallback_url, COALESCE(n.thumbnail_asset_id, shot.asset_id, master.asset_id) AS thumbnail_asset_id, COALESCE(shot.content_url, master.content_url) AS thumbnail_fallback_url FROM scenes s JOIN timeline_items ti ON ti.scene_id = s.id JOIN nodes n ON n.id = ti.video_node_id LEFT JOIN nodes shot ON shot.id = n.parent_node_id AND shot.node_type = 'SHOT' LEFT JOIN nodes master ON master.id = s.active_master_node_id AND master.node_type = 'MASTER' WHERE s.project_id = #{projectId} AND n.node_type = 'VIDEO' AND n.is_confirmed = 1 ORDER BY s.order_index ASC, s.id ASC, ti.order_index ASC, ti.id ASC LIMIT 1
